scientific_integrity: Analytic proof, symbolic checks and independently integrated energy quadratures; no claim of independent validation or empirical confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Exact classical Newtonian central-force Yukawa mathematical model; strong coupling near exp(3)/5, outside generic weak fifth-force regime; no relativistic, dissipative or finite-body effects. title: A quartic soft orbit and universal winding law at the Yukawa–Kepler cusp
